summary:
w167 planned (supervision#r92). Scenario A is green and stays so; scenario B is red for missing steps, a stand-in keyed by round kind only, and one id written for both initiatives.
Decisions: proposal id becomes capability-proposal/<context path>/<initiative>-<capability> (r92, 0027, naming of 0029/0050); draft_proposals matches work-items to a proposal by id name segment, not file stem (r72), avoiding duplicate drafting; the stand-in gets a per-node round key.
File set: supervise_change.py, supervise_draft.py, supervision_integrate_steps.py, stub_claude.py (supervision_rounds_steps.py dropped: the i2 Given goes in the integrate steps).
No existing test breaks (verified by search and the notes' runs). Open cases: repeated capability in a list (D1), '/' in a name (D2), unknown capability, initiative without id, old-form ids.
